_meta.description: Enrichment overlay for the DataVic Recreation Sites camps (the original 360 on campconditions.au). Keyed by DataVic recweb serial_no as a string (= camp "id" in scripts/build.py). Separate from manual-corrections.json, which only applies to OSM rows.
_meta.source: Explore Outdoors, exploreoutdoors.vic.gov.au (Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action)
_meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 (deeca.vic.gov.au/copyright, linked from every Explore Outdoors page footer). Images, photos and branding excluded; none used. The More to Explore app has stricter terms; nothing was taken from the app.
_meta.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action)
_meta.fees: No fee amounts recorded. fee_type is only free/paid as stated on the page.
